title: Pixel won't turn on
fullDescription: Pixel phones can fail to boot due to deep battery discharge, after a failed update, or charging hardware fault. Try a long charge first, then forced reboot, then recovery.

fixSteps.title: Bootloader / Recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Vol Down + Power to enter bootloader, then Recovery to wipe cache.

faq.a: Try Recovery > Apply update from ADB.

title: Pixel stuck on Google logo
shortDescription: Boot fails at colorful G logo.
fullDescription: Pixel hangs at the Google logo and never proceeds to Android. Common after failed OTA updates, root attempts, or partition corruption.

fixSteps.title: Wipe cache
fixSteps.instruction: Boot to Recovery, wipe cache partition.

fixSteps.title: Re-flash with Android Flash Tool
fixSteps.instruction: Use Google's Android Flash Tool from Chrome to install stock firmware.

title: Camera error - can't connect to camera
fullDescription: Pixel camera throws 'Can't connect to camera' or shows blackish screen. Often due to GCam process hanging, telephoto lens failure on Pixel 6 Pro/7 Pro, or hardware fault.

fixSteps.title: Force stop Camera + clear cache
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Apps > Camera > Storage > clear cache.

fixSteps.title: Service for hardware
fixSteps.instruction: Telephoto failures common on Pixel 6 Pro — Google Pixel Repair.

title: Pixel modem / cellular issues
fullDescription: Pixel 6 / 6 Pro / 7 / 7 Pro use Samsung Exynos modems known for connectivity issues — dropped calls, slow data, weak signal. Some fixed via Tensor firmware updates.

fixSteps.title: Update Pixel firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > System update — install latest monthly update.

fixSteps.title: Reset network settings
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > System > Reset > Reset Wi-Fi, mobile & Bluetooth.

fixSteps.title: Force LTE only
fixSteps.instruction: Dial *#*#4636#*#* > Phone information > set Preferred network to LTE.

faq.a: Pixel 8 modem is improved but still Samsung.

title: Pixel overheating
shortDescription: Tensor SoC runs hot, throttling and shutdowns.
fullDescription: Google Tensor (G1/G2) is known for thermal issues — Pixel 6/7 throttle aggressively under load and heat up during navigation, gaming, or video. Google's later updates improved this.

fixSteps.title: Remove case + lower brightness
fixSteps.instruction: Take phone out of case during heavy use.

title: Excessive battery drain
fullDescription: Pixel battery life can drop suddenly after updates. Common culprits: Google services using mobile signal in poor coverage, Now Playing feature, ambient display, and battery degradation.

fixSteps.title: Check Battery usage
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Battery > Battery usage — find highest drainer.

fixSteps.title: Disable Now Playing / AOD
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Display > Lock screen — disable Now Playing and Always-on display.

faq.a: Yes, takes a week to learn.

title: Slow under-display fingerprint
fullDescription: Pixel 6/7 use optical under-display fingerprint sensors that flash bright light and can be slow, especially with wet fingers or non-Pixel screen protectors.

fixSteps.title: Use Pixel-approved protector
fixSteps.instruction: Use Whitestone or 3M VHB style optical-friendly screen protector.

fixSteps.title: Re-register fingerprints
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Security > Fingerprint Unlock — delete and re-add.

faq.a: Yes, has ultrasonic in some markets.

title: Boot Pixel into Safe Mode
fullDescription: Safe Mode disables all third-party apps to test if a downloaded app is causing crashes, drain, or instability. Useful diagnostic tool.

fixSteps.title: Enter Safe Mode
fixSteps.instruction: Long-press Power, then long-press Power off icon, tap OK to reboot in safe mode.

fixSteps.title: Test stability
fixSteps.instruction: Use phone for a while in safe mode. If problem disappears, a third-party app is responsible.

fixSteps.title: Uninstall recent apps
fixSteps.instruction: Reboot normally and uninstall apps installed before issue began.

title: Pixel display flicker
fullDescription: Pixel OLED displays use PWM dimming which can cause flicker at low brightness for sensitive users. Some Pixel 6/7 models also have manufacturing defects causing visible flicker.

faq.a: Yes for most users; sensitive users may want anti-flicker mode.

title: Pixel charges slowly
fullDescription: Despite Google advertising 30W charging, Pixels actually peak around 21-23W due to thermal management. Using non-Google PD chargers can be even slower.

fixSteps.title: Use 30W Google charger
fixSteps.instruction: Use Google's official 30W charger and a 3A+ USB-C cable.

fixSteps.title: Disable Adaptive Charging
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Battery > Adaptive preferences > Adaptive Charging off (makes overnight charging slower by design).

fixSteps.title: Cool environment
fixSteps.instruction: Charge in cool room, remove case.

faq.a: Peak burst — actual sustained charge is lower.
